query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN zip IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as zip_is_null,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zip = 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as zip_is_string_null,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zip = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as zip_is_empty
FROM pco_people WHERE status = 'active' AND latitude IS NULL;
